baseline_note: Re-baselined after a cross-module regression audit (dev_checks/) found and fixed 3 issues: Module 7 NameError crash (project_currency), Module 4/6 blank language dropdown (StringVar garbage-collected), Module 3 component names staying in the stale language after a UI language switch. Patch numbering restarts at 1; PATCH_197-216's history is kept under PATCH/archive_pre_v2.2.0/ for reference.
feature: PATCH_011: Module 4 annual CSV export fix. Saving 年別結果CSV raised ValueError 'dict contains fields not in fieldnames: climate_temperature_offset_C, operational_change_factor, climate_energy_factor' because the CSV header was built from the first row only and the year-0 (initial construction) row of services/long_term_environment_engine_v9_3.py lacked the three climate columns the yearly rows have. (1) The year-0 row now carries the three columns (climate offset/factor from the future-climate series at year 0, operational change factor 1.0; informational only, year-0 operational CO2/energy remain 0; no other calculated value changes). (2) New core/csv_export.py writes result CSVs with the union of all row keys in first-seen order, so Project JSONs saved before PATCH_011 (short year-0 rows) also export; used by Module 4 annual/event, Module 6 cashflow and Module 7 event-cost CSV. (3) dev_checks/csv_export_fieldnames_self_check.py fails on any rows[0]-only CSV header, an incomplete year-0 row, or a runtime annual export without the three columns. Includes PATCH_010 and earlier. v2.2.0 baseline release (four-product audit). Version single source of truth: NOTICE, FINAL_RELEASE_STATUS, ROOT_MANIFEST, README and the build guide state 2.2.0 (they said 1.0.212-1.0.215); core/version.py fallback 2.2.0; VERSION.json patch is a JSON number. version_info_AZRAS_Evaluation.txt was a one-line text PyInstaller cannot eval (the EXE build stopped there); it is now a VSVersionInfo generated from VERSION.json by build_tools/make_version_info.py, which build_AZRAS_Evaluation.bat runs before PyInstaller. Obsolete APPLY_LOCATION.txt and APPLY_PATCH_154.txt removed. Added dev_checks: version_consistency, duplicate_dict_key, pyflakes_undefined_names. Market-rent contract (PATCH_009) confirmed against 03 Compare PATCH_007; no calculation change. Includes PATCH_009 and earlier. License unified to the MIT License (copyright ACE Comprehensive Consulting Co., Ltd.); LICENSE.txt and the License window now match the AZRAS-System repository LICENSE; dev_checks/license_consistency_self_check.py added. Added data/project_schema_v3_0.json: the published v2.0 schema fixed schema_version to 2.0, so every current (3.0) Project JSON failed it; dev_checks/project_schema_consistency_self_check.py keeps schema and save format equal. docs/maintenance/SCHEMA_VERSION_MAP.txt no longer states 1.0.140.
